brief.topic: What stops your agent at step 40?
brief.audience: PMs taking an agent from demo to production

coreInsight: Production agents need explicit stop conditions — step budget, time and cost ceilings, a repeated-failure stop and a human handoff — because demos never exercise them.

hooks.text: What stops your agent at step 40?
Your agent demo never had to stop.
Agents need a budget, not just a goal.

selectionRationale: Highest total (23/25): a concrete question with no comfortable answer, and the reel shows the four limits.

scenes.purpose: Show how a missing stop condition becomes a runaway loop.
scenes.onScreen: THE DEMO NEVER HIT THIS / How it runs away. / Agent plans → Calls a tool → Tool times out → Retries same call → Cost grows / Nothing told it when to stop.
scenes.voiceover: The agent plans, calls a tool, the tool times out, and it retries the same call. Again. Cost grows and the user waits. Nothing told it when to stop.

caption.opening: A demo agent runs a few steps and ends. A production agent hits a timeout and retries the same call until someone notices.
body:
Limits the demo never tested:
→ A step budget per task
→ A time and cost ceiling
→ Stop after repeated failed calls
→ Hand off to a human, with context
Then design what the user sees when it stops. A clear handoff beats a spinner that never ends.
